title: Zukunft Bestand
summary: Zukunft Bestand is a holistic concept for the ecological and socially inclusive renovation of existing housing complexes. Using two case studies representative of typical building methods of the 20th century, the book shows how measures a) preserve and inclusively improve existing structures, b) carefully integrate anything new, c) save resources and use them sensibly. The eco-social transformation, presented in the scales of settlement, building and detail, is therefore applicable to a large number of housing complexes in Austria and beyond.
